def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    vehicle_patches = image_patch.find("moving vehicle")
    if not vehicle_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Find the center of the image
    center_x = image.shape[1] / 2
    center_y = image.shape[0] / 2
    
    # Filter vehicles within the center lanes
    center_lanes = [v for v in vehicle_patches if abs(v.horizontal_center - center_x) <= 100]
    
    return center_lanes
